minutes.headline: Board endorsed the 10 Parmentor Road ANR subdivision and approved a vehicle maintenance building on Intervail Road.
minutes.summary: The Planning Board endorsed a large approval-not-required (ANR) subdivision plan at 10 Parmentor Road after resolving a lot-naming issue, confirming Round Road's status as a public way, and agreeing informally to phase future storm water permits by lot group rather than as one large permit. It also held a public hearing and approved, with standard conditions, a new vehicle maintenance building at 39 Intervail Road (the Amazon distribution site), granted a two-year time extension for the 494 Electric site plan, and discussed revising the board's standard storm water permit conditions to add inspection lists and recorded easements.

what_happened.line: Board endorsed the ANR subdivision plan for 10 Parmentor Road after confirming Round Road as a public way.
Board approved a new vehicle maintenance building at 39 Intervail Road, the Amazon distribution site, with standard conditions.
Board granted a two-year extension of the 494 Electric site plan permit.
Board informally agreed the Parmentor Road applicant can phase storm water permits by lot group instead of bonding all unbuilt lots at once.
Board discussed reorganizing its standard storm water permit conditions to add inspection lists and recorded drainage easements.

why_it_matters: The storm water phasing arrangement changes how construction guarantees work on a large subdivision, which matters to neighbors who raised drainage concerns about the new driveways.
The Intervail Road approval lets construction proceed on the Amazon site's vehicle maintenance building under specified conditions and hours.
A townwide revision to standard storm water conditions, if adopted, would apply to future site plan permits beyond this meeting.
